text: You're late.
The target didn't show up because you were sloppy.
It would be a shame if that peace was interrupted.
I did everything you asked. Three years.
New target. High priority.
If this doesn't happen by dawn, don't bother coming home to check on your mother.
Target is moving. I'm closing in.
Stay back!
I'm not here for the money, Elara.
He isn't protecting her. He's investing in her death.
He told me... he said he was the only reason she was still breathing.
That's not my ride. Marcus didn't trust me to come alone.
How many?
Four.
Where is Marcus?
The... penthouse... The Heights...
I expected you to be more discreet, Elara.
The loyalty of a mercenary is such a fragile thing, Leo.
Page... forty-two...
You're not a businessman. You're a parasite.
No. You made me a killer. Now I'm just cleaning up the mess.
Get in.
